name: Benjamin of Tudela completes Sefer Massaʿot
summary: Navarrese-Jewish merchant Benjamin ben Jonah of Tudela returns from an eight-year journey through southern France, Italy, Constantinople, Syria, Mesopotamia, Iran, Yemen, and Egypt. His Sefer Massaʿot ('Book of Travels') systematically reports on the Jewish communities of every major city he visited.

_quarry.structural_significance: Most comprehensive medieval Jewish-authored geographical account; uniquely valuable for the demographic and institutional state of the 12th-century Mediterranean and Mesopotamian Jewish diaspora (Babylonian exilarchate, Cairo Geniza-period Egypt, Norman Sicily). Continues to be cited by modern historians of medieval Jewish communities.
